steps.title: Check Claude Code CLI plugin commands

body.command: claude plugin --help 2>&1 | sed -n '30,80p' | grep -E "^\s{2}[a-z]" ; claude plugin validate --help 2>&1 | head -15

steps.title: Create plugin manifest, marketplace, and hooks

body.command: claude plugin validate . 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "--- marketplace:"; claude plugin validate .claude-plugin/marketplace.json 2>&1 | tail -8

steps.title: Stop only the bridge listening on 5175

body.command: $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5175 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { Stop-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -Force; "stopped pid $($c.OwningProcess)" } else { "not running" }

steps.title: Verify the hook auto-starts the bridge

body.command: cd /c/Dot; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "before: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 1 http://[REDACTED:ip]:5175/; node -e "process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({hook_event_name:'SessionStart',session_id:'autostart-test',cwd:process.cwd()}))" | node bridge/hook.js; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "after: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 2 http://[REDACTED:ip]:5175/

steps.title: Show which process listens on port 5175

body.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5175 -State Listen | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$($_.OwningProcess)"; "$($_.LocalAddress) pid=$($_.OwningProcess) started=$($p.CreationDate) cmd=$($p.CommandLine)" }

python - <<'EOF'
p='README.md'; s=open(p,encoding='utf8').read()
old_start = s.index('**1. Start the bridge**')
old_end = s.index('**3. Keep the pal on screen.**')
new = '''### Option A: install the Claude Code plugin (recommended)

```
/plugin marketplace add <your-github-user>/dotpals
/plugin install dotpals@dotpals
```

Then restart Claude Code and run **`/dotpals:pals`** to open the pal page. That's it. The plugin adds the hooks, and the bridge starts by itself the first time you send a prompt (set `DOTPALS_AUTOSTART=0` to turn that off).

### Option B: wire the hooks yourself

Start the bridge with `npm run bridge` (or `npx dotpals-bridge`), then add hooks to `.claude/settings.local.json` (one project) or `~/.claude/settings.json` (all
…
: "command", "command": "node /path/to/dotpals/bridge/hook.js", "async": true }] }],
    "SessionStart":     [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "node /path/to/dotpals/bridge/hook.js", "async": true }] }],
    "SessionEnd":       [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "node /path/to/dotpals/bridge/hook.js", "async": true }] }]
  }
}
```

The hooks are `async`, so they never slow Claude down, and they stay silent when the bridge isn't running. The full list the plugin uses is in [hooks/hooks.json](hooks/hooks.json).

### Keep the pal on screen

'''
s = s[:old_start] + new + s[old_end:].replace('**3. Keep the pal on screen.** ', '', 1)
open(p,'w',encoding='utf8').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "Option A\|Option B\|Keep the pal" README.md

end.title: Finished
end.summary:
```
